subject: Medivance handoff: implementation window, risks, and owners
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Handoff: Medivance — implementation window & expectations

Irene / Karthish (looping you in on the handoff),

Quick summary from Sales: Medivance verbally committed last week to a pilot (3 month) for their clinical decision-support assistant. Contracting is close — legal is reviewing the final SOW; procurement has asked for an invoice template and SOC2 evidence (see below). They want go-live for the pilot the week of Mar 23, ideally with a short staging week prior (Mar 16–20) to validate connectivity and data ingestion.

Key constraints / asks from the customer:
- Data residency: patient PII must remain in us-east-1 (they will be in a VPC).
- Model variant: prefer the quantized Llama-2 13B-compatible variant (we validated accuracy in the demo).
- Throughput expectation: ~120 concurrent short chat sessions peak (avg token lengths low).
- Integration: initial integration will be via our streaming API and a small S3 drop for transcripts.

Attachments: Medivance_SOW_v1.pdf (draft), medivance_pricing.xlsx
Related links: DocuSign envelope started (procurement asked for invoice + SOC2 link)

As the CS owner, Irene — can you confirm readiness checklist items below and proposed owners? I recommend the following quick assignment:
- CS lead / onboarding owner: Irene Choi
- Technical implementation: Karthik Iyer (infrastructure + deployment)
- Deployment QA / acceptance criteria & success metrics: Tessa Morgan
- Billing / procurement liaison: Ben Carter (Sales)

Immediate asks for next week:
1) Can CS provide a 30/60/90 onboarding timeline by Mon 2/16?
2) Karthik — are there any infra blockers for a private VPC deployment in us-east-1 for this model?
3) Irene — please confirm a single point of contact on the Medivance side and set a kickoff for week of 2/23.

Thanks — I want to keep momentum; customer indicated they will sign once SOC2 link and invoice template are provided.

— Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Handoff: Medivance — implementation window & expectations

Irene / Ben — thanks for the context. Quick technical note and preliminary risks: 

1) VPC/private deployment:
- We can stage a Private deployment in us-east-1 for the pilot. We'll need the customer's VPC peering info and a short window to validate route tables/NAT. Expect ~5 business days to stand up staging infra once we have networking details.

2) Model footprint & infra sizing:
- Llama-2 13B (quantized) fits comfortably on a pair of A10-class nodes if we rely on continuous batching and prefix cache; for 120 concurrent sessions we should size for 3 nodes to hit latency targets (p95 < 350ms) — will provide cost estimate.

3) Data flow / S3 transfer:
- Confirm the S3 ingestion will be in the same region. If they plan cross-region transfers we'll need to factor in egress and additional privacy review.

4) Acceptance criteria (draft):
- Successful end-to-end streaming response with user transcript stored to S3 (sample set)
- Latency p95 < 400ms under 80% of target concurrency during load test
- No data leakage in logs; KMS keys encrypted and access-limited

Action items I propose now: 
- Irene: schedule kickoff with Medivance and share SOW with final list of owners (by Mon 2/16).
- Ben: share procurement contact and invoice template; confirm DocuSign envelope id (so we can attach to our tracking).
- Me: I will allocate staging capacity and prepare a short runbook for VPC onboarding; I can start the networking checklist as soon as we have CIDR ranges.

Blockers to flag early: SOC2 evidence — we should provide them the SOC2 summary + audit contact. Also need to confirm whether they require dedicated hardware (they asked about "isolation"). If they want dedicated GPUs (no multi-tenant), that changes timeline/cost.

I'll prepare a short infra sizing + cost note by EOD Mon 2/16.

— Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Handoff: Medivance — implementation window & expectations

Thanks Ben / Karthik — confirming owners and adding a few operational specifics.

Owners
- CS Lead: Irene Choi (irene.choi@redwood.ai) — overall delivery owner, kickoff, weekly status
- Technical Lead: Karthik Iyer — VPC, infra sizing, deployment templates
- Acceptance + QA: Tessa Morgan — test plan, runbook, acceptance gates
- Billing: Ben Carter — invoice + procurement liaison

Kickoff 
- I'll target Tue 2/24 11:00am PT for a 60-minute kickoff with Medivance. Ben, can you confirm Lena / Rajesh availability?

30/60/90 (high level) — initial draft
- 0–2 weeks (kickoff + network prep): exchange VPC details, finalize SOW, sign DocuSign, prepare staging infra
- 2–6 weeks (integration): API integration, S3 ingestion validation, streaming response tests, early acceptance load tests
- 6–12 weeks (pilot stabilization): monitoring baseline, tweak batching/quantization, success metrics collection, handover to CS for ops

Risk log (top 3)
- Procurement delay around invoice/SOC2 (mitigation: provide SOC2 summary + audit contact, Ben to follow up)
- Networking misconfig leading to delayed staging (mitigation: dedicated networking checklist and one-hour preflight call with their network engineer)
- Dedicated hardware request (if they insist) — will need procurement & infra approval and will push timeline by ~2 weeks

Attachments referenced: Medivance_SOW_v1.pdf

I will put the kickoff invite on the calendar for Tue 2/24 and include a short pre-read. For the pre-read I'll include a checklist for the VPC details we need (CIDR, security groups, KMS key ARNs, service endpoints).

— Irene
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Rajesh Kulkarni <r.kulkarni@medivance.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medivance.com>, Procurement <procurement@medivance.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Handoff: Medivance — implementation window & expectations

Irene / Ben — thanks for the clear plan. Lena and I are available for Tue 2/24 11:00am PT. Confirmed POC on our side: Lena Ortiz (technical), Rajesh Kulkarni (project sponsor).

A couple quick procurement requests before kickoff: 
1) Please share the final invoice template (Ben) and the expected billing cadence for the pilot.
2) SOC2 evidence — we review external attestation reports. Can you send a link to Redwood's SOC2 summary + contact for audit questions?

On the technical side: we will provide VPC CIDR and a service account with limited permissions by Mon 2/23. We do not expect to require dedicated GPUs for the pilot; we'd request that as an option only if performance tuning during the first 2 weeks shows sustained p95 > 600ms.

For the kickoff agenda, please include: introductions, quick review of SOW, network checklist, basic acceptance criteria, and next steps. Looking forward to the call.

— Rajesh
Project Sponsor, Medivance
